question: What is the optimal number of additional triples to include in the local context subgraph for each target triple/path?
description: The idea proposes to enrich each target triple with additional triples from the same source passage, but it is unclear how many extra triples provide the best trade-off between contextual benefit and noise.
rationale: Too few triples may not provide sufficient context; too many may introduce irrelevant information and hinder learning.
